title: Predictive novelty contrasts with pre-state matching and explicit support limits
disposition_reason: The snapshot contains support/matching and reference-composition code, but its native source reader, response/statistical core and execution owners are omitted; operational routes explicitly refuse. The defensible target is held-mouse FIRST-versus-REPEAT response prediction under measured pre-state/history matching, with outcomes as a separate sensitivity. Exact lifetime exposure and causal novelty are not identified by the supplied variables.

scientific_target.question: On source-supported new-image pairs in held-out mice, does exposure phase improve calcium-response prediction beyond measured pre-stimulus state and within-session image history, and can the observed FIRST-minus-REPEAT contrast be recovered without imposing its sign?
scientific_target.known_answer: Protected source-derived matched response values and signed per-mouse FIRST-minus-REPEAT contrasts, together with exact catalogue/support/exclusion counts. The true contrast can be zero, negative, positive or unavailable; a favored novelty narrative is not ground truth.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Versioned Allen Visual Behavior NWB dF/F plus source event/registration metadata. Full native response/statistical producers are omitted from the public snapshot, so actual target values/support remain unresolved.
scientific_target.case_unit: Matched mouse/container/image/change/pre-state/history pair across FIRST (Novel 1) and REPEAT (Novel >1); events and registered cells are nested. A complete investigation also returns catalogue and secondary-panel support evidence.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Mouse, with all repeated sessions, containers, cells, pairs and both analysis policies retained together.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Observational held-mouse prediction and matched descriptive contrasts conditional on observed support. Familiar versus Novel is not equivalent to FIRST versus REPEAT; within-session presentation count is not exact lifetime image exposure.
exclusions: A causal novelty effect from matching, temporal order or predictive gain alone.
Matching on post-stimulus outcomes as the primary total novelty estimand.
Zero support inferred from missing catalogue/projection, or exact exposure inferred from session-level image-set exposure.

inputs: NUISANCE: cell type, image set/identity, area, depth, change, pre-running value/bin, pre-pupil quartile and within-session prior same-image count/bin. JOINT adds exposure phase only.

Pre-state windows [-0.5,0) seconds; running in cm/s, blink-masked pupil area, at least 80% finite samples and clock gaps at most 0.1 s. Pupil ranks use target-free full-session eligible rows, explicitly transductive.

FIT/validation observations and support metadata under declared roles; source metadata can establish support but does not expose query response values. Eight native post-stimulus trial flags are permitted only in the separately named outcome-conditioned sensitivity.
forbidden_inputs: Query dF/F responses, targets/reference predictions, or target-derived preprocessing.
Mouse/experiment/session ID, date/order, source paths and native current-session novelty as predictive nuisance fields; they remain joins/support evidence.
Unknown lifetime counts treated as known or missing-to-missing matching used as support.
Query category learning, query refitting/model choice and post-stimulus outcomes in the pre-state primary.
observation_contract.case_identity: Source event keys combine experiment/table/native presentation identity; behavioral identities deduplicate simultaneous imaging planes. Matched cases and query bindings require the missing original membership/native producers; no authentic final ID list is supplied.
observation_contract.split: Secondary source declares 80 mice, 204 containers and 475 experiments with original 55 FIT/11 validation/14 query mouse roles. These are source declarations, not verified membership. Preserve original assignments rather than inventing a new split; no validation refit and no query selection.
observation_contract.coverage: Full catalogue support obligation retains all declared 107 mice/703 sessions/1,936 experiment planes and all source conditions; the secondary matched panel is separately declared. Every retained/excluded source event and reason must reconcile with the complete table census. Missing membership/projection yields null, not a zero or an observed-prefix success.

primary.name: held-mouse new-image JOINT normalized RMSE
primary.aggregation: Equal mouse normalized error on the complete intended new-image matched panel using FIT-only weighted response SD. Report the evaluator-owned nuisance error minus JOINT error as a companion higher-is-better gain; no partial denominator.
primary.rationale: Tests prediction of measured responses while preventing a candidate from weakening its own nuisance baseline. The predictive endpoint is separate from source-count reconstruction and explanatory wording.

secondary: Fixed-nuisance-reference NRMSE minus JOINT NRMSE, with higher positive reduction indicating better prediction; the validation-selected evaluator comparator and identical intended query denominator are mandatory.
Signed observed/predicted FIRST-minus-REPEAT contrast per mouse and equal-mouse by cell type; absolute contrast error with no preferred biological sign.
Already-familiar-image control subset, unknown-first-image support dispositions and outcome-conditioned sensitivity, reported separately.
Exact source-derived catalogue/secondary support, overlap, event partition and exclusion-count agreement; label agreement with scripted interpretation phrases is only a consistency check.

comparators.name: evaluator-owned hierarchical mean
comparators.inputs: Same permitted FIT nuisance covariates (and phase only in JOINT); outcome flags only in sensitivity.
comparators.procedure: Implemented unexecuted weighted categorical hierarchy/fallback. Fit on all supported FIT pairs; primary validation error and scale use the new-image subset.

comparators.name: evaluator-owned HGB
comparators.inputs: Same permitted inputs and hierarchical FIT weights, with FIT-only category vocabulary/medians/missingness handling.
comparators.procedure: Four fixed HGBRegressor settings: leaves 15/31 × l2 0/1; 200 iterations, learning_rate=0.1, min_samples_leaf=20, early_stopping=False, random_state=127. Whole-mouse validation chooses setting, no refit.

comparators.name: frozen nuisance selection
comparators.inputs: Validation errors of hierarchy and selected HGB nuisance arms.
comparators.procedure: Choose smaller validation NRMSE, hierarchy wins ties; evaluator freezes the comparator before query. Candidate NUISANCE outputs remain descriptive and cannot set primary gain.

nuisance_controls: Primary matching uses pre-state and within-session history; all eight post-stimulus outcome flags move to a separately conditioned sensitivity to avoid silently changing the estimand.
Distinguish exact lifetime, session-order and relaxed within-session support profiles; missing required fields never create overlap.
Native FIRST image novelty defines new-image subset; G/H familiar images remain controls, not presumed novel.
Disclose full-session pupil-rank transduction, whole-record QC and registered-cell survival selection; these prevent online or causal interpretation.
evaluation.uncertainty: No superiority threshold, confirmatory interval or multiplicity plan is selected. Any future interval must resample whole mice, retain both policies/all nested data, respect cell-type strata and reference selection, and account for multiple support profiles and contrasts. Current descriptive source design cannot establish significance.
evaluation.failure_policy: Every planned supported case must have finite JOINT/NUISANCE outputs with exact IDs/query binding. Unknown catalogue membership, missing source projection, unsupported required mouse/pair, unknown new-image denominator or invalid FIT scale makes primary result null. Retained/excluded identities must be disjoint and exhaustive; failure preserves all missingness rather than scoring a favorable subset.

implementation.scorer_target: The included consumer compares submitted support tables to protected source-derived tables and predicts held neural response values/contrasts through an external statistical core. Its scripted interpretation-string checks are not sufficient scientific evidence. The public package lacks that core and cannot compute a complete native score.
implementation.delivered_scope: Inactive partial snapshot: 15 local programme modules and three interface documents. Twenty-one inherited files, including original NWB reader/statistical core, are omitted pending provenance review. Operational methods require missing native producers.
missing: Recover and authenticate original membership, native reader/response/statistical core and redistribution provenance.
Project complete event/support populations and separately identify exact-lifetime exposure availability without inventing counts.
Fit/validate fixed references and establish intended support/denominators before query inference.
Supply isolated participant/target owners and a measured full resource budget; define a confirmatory uncertainty plan only before outcomes.
implementation.execution_evidence: Source constructors and consumers are explicitly unexecuted on scientific data; lifecycle.require_native_producers unconditionally raises. No native data, fitted references, protected labels or scientific results were accessed by this revision.

direct_observation.representation: The complete target is a multi-mouse matched-support and held-response investigation, not one locally visible waveform label.
direct_observation.boundary: A small direct plot/question would change the statistical target and cannot replace the full support/prediction endpoint.
missing: A separately justified interpretation condition would need its own known-answer case definition while preserving this investigation as the registered objective.

typed_viewer.representation: Possible inspection of measured response/support plots within an investigation; no typed renderer or full statistical backend is supplied.
typed_viewer.boundary: Visual inspection can support interpretation but cannot prove complete matching, quantify omitted rows or replace protected numerical scoring.
missing: Complete statistical/source closure, then define auditable plot tools without exposing held responses.

tool_assisted.representation: Partial source composes support analysis, paired prediction products and an explanatory report; no actual live investigator transport/native core exists.
tool_assisted.boundary: Candidate report is retained, while protected source tables and predictions independently assess claims; access/resource equality and target isolation require missing owners.
missing: Restore native core/producers and implement actual per-case tool transport with protected quantitative evaluation.

frozen_program.representation: Fixed reference recipes and prospective candidate model outputs exist as source; no complete participant frozen-programme execution route is delivered.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze model family, FIT/validation selection and all preprocessing before query; maximum five FIT attempts per arm is a design declaration, not runtime enforcement.
missing: Complete native code/ownership closure and enforce fit/selection/candidate budgets before running any programme.

evidence.supports: Preserved registered scientific question and source provenance before this revision.

evidence.locator: Visual Behavior Optical Physiology datasets, 2-photon imaging during behavior, and v1.1.0 changelog; checked 2026-11-16
evidence.supports: Official source defines repeated mouse imaging, image changes and omissions, NWB dF/F, and aligned behavior. Published imaging planes and repeated cells are nested observations, not independent mice.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: These source archives do not report a neural solver pilot for this task. The four historical neural programme attempts concern NEURAL-007/077; they do not qualify this task or any direct/viewer condition.
excluded_claims: Causal novelty identification, positive novelty effect or significant gain from source design.
Complete runtime or direct neural interpretation from the partial metadata/matching snapshot.

summary: Replace the broad causal-sounding novelty question with measurable held-mouse prediction and unsigned-evidence contrast recovery.
Keep outcomes out of the primary pre-state estimand and explicitly separate lifetime-exposure unavailability from within-session matching.
Treat support-table reconstruction and scripted interpretation labels as supporting checks, not substitutes for held neural-response performance.
revision.source_review: Inspected the preserved task and the named current implementation, preparation and scoring source. Checked the official AllenSDK dataset documentation; did not open authentic neural/behavioral payloads or run scientific stages.
